description: Intel is pushing to be the first to adopt PCIe 5, but has also added DDR5 to its roadmap for future CPUs. We also talk about the Huawei losses, DDR4 OC, and more. Ad: Buy Thermaltake's C360 Kit on Amazon (https://geni.us/LWNv5AW)  Show notes: https://www.gamersnexus.net/industry/3478-hw-news-intel-pcie5-ddr5-cpus-6ghz-ddr4-huawei-ban  This hardware news episode primarily talks about upcoming Rapid Falls and Granite Falls Intel server CPUs with PCIe 5.0 and DDR5 on the roadmap, targeting 2021, which will eventually lead to consumer product adoption of the technologies. Additionally, also in memory news, DDR4 has now been overclocked nearing ever closer to 6GHz.  We spend a significant portion of hardware news talking about Huawei losing AMD, Intel, Qualcomm, Broadcom, and other contracts, impacting both Huawei's ability to operate (especially with the loss of Android and Google) and the US tech companies' bottom lines. Computex 2019 is this week, so news is just getting started!  We have a new GN store: https://store.gamersnexus.net/  Like our content?
